children: India’s semiconductor ambitions are entering their next phase, with close to ₹1 lakh crore of investment already seen, IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said. He outlined the six pillars of Semicon 2.0 and explained why policy certainty, talent and design capabilities could help India emerge as a trusted global value-chain partner.

title: Ashwini Vaishnaw outlines six pillars of India’s Semicon 2.0 push
